title: linux-admin 1.18.18 — routing and NAT consolidated into network
summary: Top-level skill count is now 66. The former iproute-expert, routing-expert and natting-expert are retired after their route/policy-routing/iproute2, namespace/VRF/tunnel, SNAT/DNAT/masquerade/port-forwarding, forwarding and conntrack guidance was preserved and expanded in network/chunks/routing-iproute.md and network/chunks/nat-conntrack.md. Firewall, proxy and DNS remain distinct control planes. The latest published GitHub Release remains v1.17.74.
